question.text: The Portfolio Investment Scheme (PIS) is administered by:

explanation.text: The Logic: The Portfolio Investment Scheme (PIS) is administered by the Reserve Bank of India for NRI investment in listed Indian equity through designated bank accounts. The Trap: SEBI, IRDAI and PFRDA are not the administering authority for PIS. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-A PMS Distributors workbook (Sep 2025), pages 166-167.
